text: {"observations": [{"unit_ids": ["D0fe555d2cf.P015.S003"], "anchor": null, "reason": "Does a business-friendly regulatory environment and strong rule of law increase foreign direct investment inflows?"},{"unit_ids": ["D0fe555d2cf.P066.S007"], "anchor": "If you enter our country as a visitor, and as a visitor in our country – be it a student, a tourist, a journalist, whatever you want to be – and you undertake activities that are against the national interest and national security of the United States, we will take away your visa.", "reason": "Does revoking visas of foreign nationals for national-security reasons deter targeted speech or behaviour?"},{"unit_ids": ["D0fe555d2cf.P043.S003", "D0fe555d2cf.P043.S005"], "anchor": null, "reason": "What are the economic costs of concentrated supply-chain dependence on a single country, and what are the gains from diversification?"}]}
